jobs.description: Company Overview At Motorola Solutions, we believe that everything starts with our people. We're a global close-knit community, united by the relentless pursuit to help keep people safer everywhere. We build and connect technologies to help protect people, property and places. Our solutions foster the collaboration that's critical for safer communities, safer schools, safer hospitals, safer businesses, and ultimately, safer nations. Connect with a career that matters, and help us build a safer future. Department Overview Would you like to become a part of a company that uses the newest technology platforms in communications, software, video and servicesDo you want to work with people who help save other people's livesDo you consider yourself to be a creative thinker and complex problem solverIf the answer is yes, join our rapidly expanding IT team. Our IT organization isn't just here to support our business. We're here to reinvent it - by changing the way our customers, partners and employees interact with our company. To do that, we're looking for people who bring great ideas and who make our partners' ideas better. Intellectually curious advisors (not order takers) who focus on outcomes to creatively solve business problems. People who not only embrace change, but who accelerate it. Job Description Analyze, develop, design, and maintain software for the organization's products and systems. Perform system integration of software and hardware to maintain throughput and program consistency. Develop, validate, and test structures and user documentation. Possess a strong foundation in building AI-powered applications. Design, build, and deploy scalable web applications while seamlessly integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) and intelligent features into our core product. You will bridge the gap between robust traditional web architecture, critical database infrastructure, and cutting-edge generative AI capabilities. Scope of Responsibilities/Expectations Install, configure and administer databases, including and not limited to, Oracle, MS SQL, and Open source technologies like MySQL, MongoDB, Postgresql, etc. hosted in AWS, OCI and On-Premises infrastructure Strong knowledge for script programming (e.g bash, Python, JScript etc) Develop prototypes and proof of concept solutions. Prepare effort estimates, detailed execution plans, delivery schedules. Develop maintain documentation for assigned projects including install guide, troubleshooting guide, SOP, etc. Track latest database solutions in the industry to drive technology refresh. Provide support per project needs; investigate and troubleshoot issues; perform regular log analysis, security monitoring to identify any possible intrusions. Liaisons with the Infrastructure team, Application team, Architecture team, third parties, as necessary. Specific Knowledge/Skills Technical Skills: Experience in Open source database technologies like MySQL, MongoDB, PostgreSQL Experience in database administration in cloud infrastructure (AWS/OCI/Azure) Hands-on experience in managing AWS EC2/OCI VM. Experience in Integrating open-source LLMs into our application architecture via APIs. Experience in Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG) pipelines, managing data ingestion, chunking, embedding, and retrieval using Vector Databases.Optimize prompts to ensure AI outputs are accurate, secure, and aligned with business logic Experience in standard operating procedures to perform pre and post-production support activities. Experience in troubleshooting and documenting issues, gaps, and resolutions. Able to provide incident management expert-level support to the Operations team as needed. Soft Skills: Manage project task execution independently and get all associated team members to deliver their tasks on time, both with and without direct authority. Self-motivated, work independently or as part of a team, able to learn quickly, meet deadlines and demonstrate problem-solving skills. Highly organized and thorough, with an ability to facilitate communication and scheduling among different levels of staf Ability to perform under pressure, handling interruptions and changes without losing productivity and plan assignments and monitor performance according to priorities as demonstrated by regularly meeting established deadlines Ability to provide consistent follow-through with the Team Manager and IT Project manager on issues/concerns to ensure appropriate visibility and escalation where needed. Excellent verbal and written communication skills Excellent interpersonal skills with the ability to interact with others in a consistently positive manner, exercising discretion and tact Excellent written communication skills with the ability to draft clear, concise specifications, documentation, and reports Basic Requirements 3+ years of experience as an IT Software Engineer Knowledge of Software Development Lifecycle tools and technologies 3+ Years of experience with Python, JScript or equivalent 2+ Years of Unix and Windows System Administration experience Experience with microservices and container orchestration BS/MS Degree in Computer Science and/or related field Travel Requirements Under 10% Relocation Provided None Position Type Experienced Referral Payment Plan Yes EEO Statement Motorola Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer. All qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion or belief, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, veteran status or any other legally-protected characteristic. We are proud of our people-first and community-focused culture, empowering every Motorolan to be their most authentic self and to do their best work to deliver on the promise of a safer world. If you'd like to join our team but feel that you don't quite meet all of the preferred skills, we'd still love to hear why you think you'd be a great addition to our team. 3-8 Yrs Cloud Infrastructure, Container, Communication skills, Administration, Application, Bash, Orchestration, DBMS

jobs.title: Onboarding Automation Engineer
jobs.description: Role Overview Amagis Customer Experience team deliveto 50 linear channels every week to OTT, FAST, cable and smart-TV platforms around the world, and every delivery is quality-checked before it goes live. Today much of that QA is done by people watching streams for hours and checking EPG and metadata by hand. As an Onboarding Automation Engineer, you will design and build, from scratch, the automated testing system that does this work: a scalable, API-driven platform that checks video, audio, subtitles, ads, EPG and metadata the way a viewer would experience them. This is a software development role, not a manual testing role. You will build the system that the QA team uses, and you will own its adoption. You will sit within the QA team, work with Python, AWS, FFmpeg, OpenCV and AI models, and partner with delivery engineers, product and engineering. Within your first six months, the goal is a fully functioning system that tests video, SSAI, EPG and metadata for at least four tier-1 platforms. Location: Bengaluru What you will own Automated Delivery QA Platform: Design and build, from the ground up, an API-driven automated testing system that validates every linear channel delivery before it goes live. Define the test catalogue and pass/fail metrics with the QA team, and turn the requirements of close to 600 distribution platforms into configurable, reusable test cases, starting with tier-1 platforms such as Samsung TV Plus, LG Channels and Roku. Build pre-QA checks that catch stream, configuration and metadata errors before a delivery reaches QC, raising the first-time QA pass rate. Make the system easy for the QA and delivery teams to adopt: self-service test runs, clear reports, and integration with the tools they already use, such as Jira and Slack. Video, Audio, and Ad Validation: Detect visual defects the way a viewer sees them: black or frozen frames, pixelation and macroblocking, visible interlacing and other on-screen artefacts, using OpenCV and vision models rather than relying only on stream metadata. Build accurate, cost-effective detection of audio-video sync drift, where PTS timestamps alone cannot be trusted, along with missing or silent audio, channel layout and loudness issues. Validate closed captions and subtitles: presence, on-screen position, and timing against the audio. Validate SSAI and monetisation: SCTE-35 markers, ad break signalling, and whether ad replacement actually happens in the delivered stream. Check HLS and DASH streams against each platforms requirements: renditions, bitrates, codecs, resolution and manifest structure. EPG and Metadata Validation: Automate EPG and metadata checks across XMLTV, JSON and platform-specific formats: schedules, ratings, languages and required fields. Use OCR and vision models to validate artwork, for example whether an image carries the required title treatment, and whether titles and descriptions match what is actually playing. Bring existing validation scripts, such as the Roku EPG framework and the pre-QA checks on the delivery board, into the common platform. Scalable, Cost-Efficient Infrastructure: Architect the system on AWS so it scales out with delivery volume (40 to 50 channels a week and growing) and scales back when there is nothing to test. Process many concurrent streams efficiently, choosing between CPU, GPU, OpenCV and hosted AI models (for example through Amazon Bedrock) based on accuracy and cost per test. Containerise and deploy services with Docker, Kubernetes or serverless components, managed as infrastructure as code, and integrate them into CI/CD pipelines (Git, Jenkins). Add monitoring, alerting and logging so that failures in the platform itself are found and fixed quickly. Quality, Performance, and Reliability: Measure the accuracy of every automated check against human QA results, and drive down false positives and false negatives so the QA team trusts the system. Analyse recurring delivery and QC failures, and turn them into new tests and pre-checks. Keep historical reports and artefacts (HTML, JSON, recordings) for audit and debugging. Own the stability of the platform, maintaining 99.9% uptime. Collaboration and Reporting: Work with the QA lead and delivery engineers to prioritise test cases by business impact and platform. Track progress against a 30-60-90 day plan and give regular updates to your manager. Document the system and its APIs so other teams can add tests and plug it into their own workflows. What are we looking for 2-5 years of software development experience, with a track record of building backend systems or automation frameworks from scratch, not only writing test scripts. Strong hands-on programming experience in Python, including services, APIs and concurrent processing. Hands-on experience with video and audio analysis tools such as FFmpeg/FFprobe, MediaInfo and OpenCV. Working knowledge of streaming technologies: HLS, DASH, SRT, codecs, bitrates and adaptive renditions. Familiarity with server-side ad insertion (SSAI) and SCTE-35, or the ability to learn them quickly. Experience designing scalable, cost-efficient systems on AWS (EC2 Auto Scaling, ECS/EKS, Lambda, S3, SQS), and familiarity with AWS Media Services. Experience with Docker, Kubernetes, infrastructure as code (Terraform or similar), Git and Jenkins or equivalent CI/CD tools. Experience using AI/ML models, OCR, vision models or LLM APIs in production, and the judgement to know when they are accurate and cheap enough to use. Experience with REST APIs, JSON/XML schema validation, and a relational database such as PostgreSQL. Experience with monitoring and observability tools. The ability to reason about a problem from first principles, for example how to detect audio-video sync issues from the viewers side, and propose a practical, cost-effective solution. Clear written and verbal communication, with the ability to give regular status updates. Ownership mindset and the ability to work independently on a greenfield system in a fast-paced environment. Customer-focused mindset: you understand that a defect your system misses reaches a customers viewers. Good to have Experience with broadcast, OTT or FAST delivery, EPG formats such as XMLTV, smart-TV platforms or device test labs, and test frameworks such as Pytest or Robot Framework. jobs.title: Senior AI Engineering Manager
jobs.description: AI Engineering & Software Manager About the Role We are seeking a high-performing AI Engineering & Software Manager with 1318 years of deep enterprise experience to lead the execution, deployment, and operationalization of artificial intelligence across our ecosystem. In this role, you will bridge the gap between complex software engineering, cutting-edge Generative AI frameworks, and reliable production operations. The ideal candidate possesses a combination of deep technical expertise in core software engineering and AI/ML system development, along with exceptional delivery leadership. You should be an end-to-end owner who thrives on building robust AI infrastructure, scaling production workflows, navigating complex enterprise systems, and delivering high-value use cases. Key Responsibilities 1. AI Delivery, Quality Execution & End-to-End Ownership Production Delivery: Drive end-to-end delivery of AI initiatives, from initial prototyping, code review, and architecture integration to secure private cloud deployment and production scaling. Operational Excellence: Transition manually intensive IT processes into optimized, insight-driven, autonomous AI systems with strict uptime, performance, and monitoring benchmarks. 2. Technical Governance & Core AI Architecture Reusable Capability Deployment: Lead the engineering of reusable foundational AI capabilities, including containerized pretrained models, adaptation workflows, optimization recipes, and production-ready reference implementations. Hands-on Technical Direction: Enforce technical standards for model architecture, representation learning, self-supervised learning, generative modeling, and multimodal learning, with attention to model efficiency, latency, and hardware constraints. Research-to-Product Transition: Convert promising prototypes into validated, reproducible, scalable, and adoptable enterprise solutions with clear performance thresholds and responsible AI safeguards. Engineering Architectural Oversight: Provide technical oversight for live AI products, ensuring efficient context management, seamless tool integrations through Model Context Protocol (MCP), and secure data handling. 3. Evaluation, MLOps & Infrastructure Operations Production Quality Gates: Establish and enforce model verification and validation strategies, including objective benchmark design, robustness testing, data quality metrics, human-in-the-loop validation, and product quality gates. Infrastructure & Compute Management: Partner with platform, infrastructure, and data engineering teams to manage compute resources, data pipelines, experiment tracking, artifact registries, observability tools, and automated deployment paths. 4. Stakeholder Alignment & Delivery Negotiation Internal Consultation: Act as the primary technical consultant to IT infrastructure, support, and business units to identify and engineer high-value AI use cases. Matrix Navigation: Work effectively with engineering leads, product owners, legal, privacy, and global business teams to resolve dependencies and secure deployment resources. Technical Communication: Translate complex architectural trade-offs, engineering risks, and infrastructure constraints into clear, value-driven outcomes for senior leadership. 5. Team Engineering Leadership & Culture Talent Growth: Hire, mentor, and develop a high-performing team of engineers and applied research scientists, cultivating an engineering culture that balances technical creativity with structured development practices and measurable product impact. Qualifications & Experience Experience Required Total Professional Experience: 13–18 years in the IT/software industry, with a proven track record of delivering and scaling large-scale enterprise systems. Core Software Engineering: 6–7+ years of hands-on experience in core software engineering, systems architecture, or enterprise IT development. AI/ML Domain Expertise: At least 7+ years of dedicated engineering experience in the AI/ML domain, with a recent and significant focus on productionizing and operating Generative AI solutions in live environments. Team Management: Proven experience managing, scaling, and leading technical teams focused on foundation models, multimodal systems, Generative AI, or applied machine learning operations. Education Academic Background: Bachelor's, Master's, or PhD in Computer Science, Electrical Engineering, Machine Learning, Applied Mathematics, Physics, or a related technical field. An advanced degree is preferred. Technical Skills & Competencies Cloud-Native Infrastructure: Deep practical experience orchestrating containerized workloads using Kubernetes (K8s), managing distributed clusters, and configuring specialized GPU workloads, including NVIDIA NVLink and A100/H100 allocations. Model Serving & Inference: Hands-on experience optimizing model serving and runtime execution using enterprise frameworks such as Triton Inference Server, vLLM, or TGI to manage high-throughput, low-latency applications. Generative & Agentic Orchestration: Proficiency in building resilient, enterprise-grade AI pipelines and multi-agent workflows using frameworks such as LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, or AutoGen. MLOps Lifecycle & Observability: Expert knowledge of the full ML lifecycle using MLflow or Weights & Biases for experiment tracking and model registries, alongside observability tools such as Prometheus, Grafana, Arize, and TruLens for LLM tracking. Enterprise Infrastructure Fluency: Strong architectural knowledge of secure CI/CD pipelines, middleware, configuration management, and complex enterprise IT systems. Modality Execution: Experience handling and deploying model workflows across one or more modalities, including audio, speech, music, video, image, text, or multimodal systems. Leadership & Delivery Skills Clear Technical Communication: Ability to communicate technical trade-offs, runtime risks, and performance limitations effectively to both system administrators and executive leadership. Execution Focus: A proactive builder who takes ownership, handles infrastructure ambiguity, and prioritizes operational system stability. Delivery-Driven Prioritization: Ability to prioritize AI engineering investments based on technical feasibility, execution risk, compute costs, and actual customer adoption value. Target Metrics & Key Performance Indicators (KPIs) The incoming manager will be directly accountable for the following operational and engineering benchmarks: Operational Stability & SLAs: Maintain at least 99.9% uptime SLA for core AI services, meet target p95/p99 latency thresholds, and limit production inference exception rates to less than 0.1%. Delivery & Deployment Velocity: Enable engineering workflows supporting daily or multi-week rolling deployments through automated progressive rollouts (canary/blue-green). Reduce prototype-to-production cycles (MLflow to Triton/vLLM) to less than 5 business days. Engineering Rigor & Code Quality: Enforce a minimum of 85% test coverage across core application layers, ensure zero critical vulnerabilities pass static analysis gates (SonarQube/Snyk), and maintain 100% peer-review compliance. Resource Optimization: Maintain at least 75% average GPU utilization across Kubernetes clusters and continuously optimize context routing and token-spend parameters. 16-20 Yrs Senior, Machine learning, Machine, Management, Engineering, Intelligence, Python, Engineering management

We build AI-powered systems that help businesses save time, reduce operational costs, improve customer experience, generate more leads and automate repetitive business processes. About the Role We are looking for an experienced and technically skilled AI Automation Engineer who can independently design, develop, integrate, test and deploy AI-powered automation systems for our international clients. The ideal candidate must have a strong technical background, preferably a B.Tech or B.E. qualification, along with practical experience in AI development, workflow automation, API integrations and software engineering. You will be responsible for converting business requirements into functional, reliable and scalable AI automation solutions. This is a hands-on engineering role. We are looking for someone who can build complete automation systems rather than someone with only theoretical knowledge of AI tools. Key Responsibilities Design, develop and deploy AI-powered automation workflows for businesses. Build complex workflow automations using n8n, Make and Zapier. Develop AI agents using OpenAI, Claude and other large language models (LLMs). Build intelligent AI chatbots and customer support automation systems. Develop AI voice agents for inbound and outbound customer calls. Integrate AI systems with CRM platforms such as GoHighLevel, HubSpot and Salesforce. Develop WhatsApp, SMS and email automation workflows. Integrate third-party applications using REST APIs, webhooks and external services. Build automated lead generation, lead qualification, appointment booking and follow-up systems. Develop automated sales, marketing and customer management workflows. Connect AI systems with websites, databases and business applications. Work with AI models, prompt engineering and agent-based architectures. Troubleshoot, debug, test and optimise automation workflows. Ensure automation systems are secure, reliable, scalable and properly documented. Collaborate with international clients and internal teams to understand technical requirements. Manage multiple automation projects and deliver solutions within agreed deadlines. Required Technical Skills 1. AI & Machine Learning Strong understanding of Artificial Intelligence and Generative AI. Practical experience integrating OpenAI, ChatGPT API and Claude API. Understanding of Large Language Models (LLMs). Experience developing AI agents and intelligent conversational systems. Knowledge of prompt engineering and AI model integrations. Understanding of RAG (Retrieval-Augmented Generation) is preferred. 2. Workflow Automation Hands-on experience with n8n is highly preferred. Experience with Make (Integromat) or Zapier. Ability to build complex multi-step automation workflows. Strong understanding of workflow logic, triggers, conditions, loops and error handling. 3. Programming & Development Strong knowledge of Python and/or JavaScript. Understanding of backend development and software architecture. Experience working with JSON, databases and SQL. Ability to write custom scripts and develop API integrations. Strong debugging and problem-solving capabilities. 4. API & System Integrations Strong understanding of REST APIs and webhooks. Experience with API authentication, OAuth and third-party integrations. Ability to connect multiple software applications and platforms. Experience integrating CRM systems, communication platforms and business applications. 5. Cloud & Deployment Knowledge of cloud platforms such as AWS, Google Cloud or Azure. Experience with hosting, deployment and server management. Understanding of Docker and basic DevOps practices is an advantage. Familiarity with database management and cloud infrastructure. Additional Advantageous Skills Candidates with practical experience in the following technologies will have an advantage: GoHighLevel (GHL) CRM automation. Vapi and Retell AI voice agents. ElevenLabs voice technology. Twilio integrations. WhatsApp Business API. Supabase and Airtable. Pinecone and other vector databases. LangChain and LangGraph. WordPress and website integrations. Google Sheets and third-party business applications. AI-powered sales and marketing automation. Customer support and appointment-booking automation. Educational Qualifications & Experience B.Tech / B.E. in Computer Science, Information Technology, Software Engineering or a related technical discipline is required. 2-5 years of relevant professional experience in software development, AI development, automation engineering or system integrations. Demonstrable hands-on experience building and deploying real-world automation projects. Strong understanding of programming, APIs, databases and software development principles. Previous experience working with international clients is an advantage. A portfolio, GitHub profile or demonstration of previously developed AI automation projects is highly desirable. Candidates must have practical development experience and should be capable of independently handling technical projects. Communication & Professional Skills Excellent written and spoken English communication skills. Confidence participating in technical meetings with UK and US clients. Ability to explain complex technical concepts in simple business language. Strong analytical and problem-solving skills. Ability to understand client requirements and translate them into technical solutions. Self-motivated, organised and capable of working independently. Comfortable working in a remote, international team environment. Strong ownership, accountability and attention to detail. What We Offer Competitive salary based on experience and technical expertise. Opportunity to work with international clients across the UK and US. Exposure to the latest AI technologies and automation platforms. Opportunity to build real-world AI agents and business automation systems. Remote working environment. Professional growth and opportunities to develop advanced AI engineering skills. Opportunity to contribute to a growing international AI automation company. Who We're Looking For We are looking for a skilled engineer who understands both software development and practical AI implementation. You should be someone who can take a business problem, identify the right technology and independently build a working automation solution. We value practical experience, technical expertise, problem-solving ability and a genuine interest in AI innovation. If you have a strong technical background and want to work on real-world AI automation projects for international businesses, we would love to hear from you. Application Process Please submit your updated CV along with: Details of your previous AI automation and software development projects. Links to your GitHub profile or portfolio, if available. Examples of automation workflows or AI agents you have developed. Details of your experience with n8n, APIs, Python, JavaScript and AI integrations. Shortlisted candidates will be required to complete a practical technical assessment to demonstrate their ability to build and deploy an AI-powered automation workflow. Join BizzFree AI Ltd and help businesses worldwide transform their operations through AI-powered automation. 2-5 Yrs Automation, Node.js, Artificial Intelligence, Automation engineering, Coding, React.js

jobs.title: ML Developer
jobs.description: About the Role We are looking for an ML Developer with 6+ years of experience to design, build, and deploy machine learning solutions supporting the surveillance function within a financial services environment. You will apply advanced ML techniques anomaly detection, NLP, behavioural analytics, and classification models — to enhance communication and trade surveillance capabilities, helping detect market abuse, misconduct, and compliance breaches at scale. Key Responsibilities Design, develop, and deploy ML models for surveillance use cases — anomaly detection, behavioural analytics, NLP-based communication analysis, and pattern recognition across large-scale financial data. Build and maintain NLP pipelines — text classification, sentiment analysis, entity recognition, and semantic similarity — for electronic communication surveillance. Develop and maintain feature engineering pipelines — extracting, transforming, and selecting relevant features from trade, communication, and market data for ML model training. Train, evaluate, and optimise ML models — applying supervised, unsupervised, and semi-supervised learning techniques for surveillance detection and alert prioritisation. Integrate ML models into surveillance platforms — deploying models as REST APIs or batch inference pipelines for production consumption. Implement model monitoring and drift detection — ensuring surveillance models maintain accuracy, reliability, and performance in production. Collaborate with surveillance analysts, compliance teams, and data engineers — translating surveillance business requirements into well-designed ML solutions. Support alert tuning and false positive reduction — applying ML-driven approaches to improve surveillance detection quality and operational efficiency. Produce clear technical documentation — model design documents, feature specifications, and deployment runbooks. What We're Looking For 6+ years of ML development experience with strong Python and machine learning expertise in production environments. Strong ML skills — supervised, unsupervised, and semi-supervised learning — applied to anomaly detection, classification, and behavioural analytics use cases. Proven NLP expertise — text classification, sentiment analysis, named entity recognition, and semantic search using spaCy, NLTK, Hugging Face, or equivalent. Strong Python proficiency — NumPy, pandas, Scikit-learn, TensorFlow, or PyTorch — for ML model development and data processing. Experience with feature engineering — extracting and transforming features from structured and unstructured financial data for ML model training. Hands-on ML model deployment experience — REST API serving, batch inference, and containerised model deployment using Docker. Experience with MLflow or equivalent — experiment tracking, model versioning, and model registry management. Solid SQL skills — data querying and validation across large-scale financial datasets. Good understanding of financial services compliance or surveillance domain — communication surveillance, trade surveillance, or market abuse detection. Strong AWS experience — SageMaker, S3, Lambda, or equivalent — for ML model training and deployment. Excellent communication skills — presenting ML findings, model performance, and surveillance insights to compliance and technology stakeholders. Nice to Have Experience with LLMs and GenAI — GPT, Claude, or Llama — for advanced communication surveillance and intelligent alert summarisation. Familiarity with surveillance platforms — NICE Actimize, Behavox, or equivalent — and their ML integration patterns. Knowledge of graph-based ML — network analysis and entity relationship modelling for market abuse detection. Exposure to real-time streaming ML — Kafka or AWS Kinesis — for real-time surveillance alert generation. Experience with explainability frameworks — SHAP, LIME — for model transparency and regulatory audit support. Knowledge of regulatory frameworks — MiFID II, MAR, ASIC Market Integrity Rules — and their surveillance implications. AWS Certified Machine Learning Specialty certification. Experience in Financial Services, Banking, or regulated industry environments. 7-12 Yrs Machine learning, Machine, Ml, Numpy, Python, Development, Pandas

jobs.description: Enterprise GenAI Solutions | LLM Architecture | Agentic AI | Production Engineering Experience: 3–6 years overall, including a minimum of 3 years of hands-on Generative AI solution engineering experience Role Level: Senior AI Engineer / Lead GenAI Engineer (Individual Contributor) Primary Focus: Architect, engineer, deploy, and scale enterprise-grade Generative AI applications Mandatory: Proven production deployment experience. Proofs of Concept (PoCs), prototypes, hackathons, and experimental trials will not qualify toward the mandatory 3 years of production GenAI experience. A. GenAI Solution Architecture & Engineering Design end-to-end enterprise GenAI application architectures covering UI, API gateways, orchestration, model inference, retrieval, enterprise data integration, observability, security, and infrastructure. Build production-grade LLM-powered applications for enterprise knowledge management, intelligent document processing, engineering assistants, workflow automation, and decision support. Design architectures supporting multi-tenancy, high availability, fault tolerance, scalability, extensibility, and disaster recovery. Implement structured outputs, function/tool calling, context engineering, memory management, and intelligent model routing. Evaluate architectural trade-offs among hosted proprietary models, open-weight models, self-hosted inference, and hybrid deployments. Design model-agnostic integration layers to minimize vendor lock-in. Apply asynchronous processing, caching, batching, rate limiting, and fallback strategies to optimize production applications. B. Advanced RAG & Enterprise Knowledge Systems Architect and implement advanced RAG systems with production-ready ingestion, indexing, retrieval, generation, and evaluation. Develop document ingestion and processing pipelines for PDFs, Office documents, HTML, structured data, and scanned content. Implement semantic chunking, metadata-aware indexing, embedding strategies, hybrid search, and reranking. Design query rewriting, multi-query retrieval, hierarchical retrieval, and advanced retrieval patterns where appropriate. Integrate vector databases and enterprise search platforms. Ensure document-level and user-level access controls are preserved during retrieval. Establish mechanisms for source attribution, grounded answers, hallucination reduction, and retrieval quality monitoring. Manage document versioning, re-indexing, incremental ingestion, and data freshness. C. Agentic AI & Workflow Orchestration Design and implement multi-step, tool-using AI agents with explicit workflow orchestration and state management. Build controlled agentic workflows using LangGraph, equivalent orchestration frameworks, or custom implementations. Integrate AI agents with enterprise APIs, databases, business applications, and automation platforms. Implement guardrails, human-in-the-loop approval gates, tool authorization, and escalation mechanisms. Apply bounded autonomy, execution limits, timeout handling, idempotency, retries, and compensating transactions. Maintain auditable decision traces, tool execution records, and explanations for consequential agent actions. Evaluate the suitability of deterministic workflows versus agent-based architectures based on business risks and requirements. D. Production Engineering, LLMOps & Scalability Develop scalable backend services using Python, FastAPI, REST APIs, and asynchronous programming. Package and deploy applications using Docker, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud-native infrastructure. Establish production-grade LLMOps practices covering model configuration, prompt versioning, evaluation gates, deployment, monitoring, and rollback. Implement observability across application traces, model calls, retrieval operations, agent execution, and infrastructure. Optimize p50/p95/p99 latency, throughput, token consumption, inference cost, and infrastructure utilization. Implement load testing, performance benchmarking, failure recovery, and production incident management. Support cloud, hybrid, and on-premises deployment environments. Define service-level objectives (SLOs), operational runbooks, and production support processes. E. AI Quality, Evaluation & Responsible AI Develop automated evaluation pipelines for retrieval performance, answer faithfulness, relevance, completeness, and task success. Build representative golden datasets and regression test suites. Implement human evaluation and LLM-as-judge methodologies with appropriate calibration and validation. Evaluate agents for tool-selection correctness, workflow completion, policy compliance, and unsafe actions. Implement controls against prompt injection, sensitive data leakage, unauthorized tool execution, and insecure retrieval. Apply enterprise IAM, RBAC/ABAC, encryption, secrets management, audit logging, and data retention requirements. Work within applicable AI governance and security standards, including relevant practices from ISO/IEC 42001 and OWASP guidance for LLM applications. F. Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) & Stakeholder Engagement A critical requirement of this role is the ability to operate as a Forward Deployed Engineer, combining technical depth with direct business engagement and accountable delivery. Work directly with customers and business stakeholders to understand operational challenges and translate them into viable AI solution architectures. Lead technical discovery, requirements engineering, feasibility assessment, solution design, implementation, and production deployment. Independently investigate complex enterprise environments, legacy applications, data constraints, and integration challenges. Develop reusable architectural patterns, accelerators, deployment templates, and AI engineering assets. Conduct architecture reviews and explain design decisions to engineering teams, leadership, and non-technical stakeholders. Drive adoption, knowledge transfer, user enablement, and operational handover. Take ownership of delivered solutions beyond release, including performance, stability, business value, and continuous improvement. Roles and Responsibilities We are seeking a highly capable, hands-on Senior Generative AI Engineer with strong Forward Deployed Engineering (FDE) capabilities to architect, build, integrate, and operate scalable, secure, production-grade AI solutions. The ideal candidate must demonstrate deep expertise in Large Language Models (LLMs), Retrieval-Augmented Generation (RAG), agentic AI, AI application architecture, cloud-native engineering, and enterprise system integration. Responsibilities Writing clean and efficient code Assisting in the development of applications and software solutions Participating in code reviews and team meetings Troubleshooting and debugging applications Contributing to documentation and testing efforts Skills Basic understanding of Python programming language Familiarity with web frameworks such as Flask or Django Knowledge of database management systems like MySQL or PostgreSQL Understanding of RESTful APIs and web services Problem-solving skills and a willingness to learn Good communication and teamwork abilities Tools Python (version 3.x) Integrated Development Environment such as PyCharm or VS Code Git for version control SQL for database interactions Basic knowledge of HTML, CSS, and JavaScript is a plus Familiarity with Agile development methodologies Qualifications This is an excellent opportunity for recent graduates or individuals looking to start their career in software development. Disclaimer: This job posting has been aggregated from external source. Role details, content, and availability are subject to change. Applicants are advised to confirm the latest information directly on the company website before applying. nan nan
